== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Lone Pilot (V) (Errata 2)]], showing the '''PC-E2''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The slips ([[:File:VB6-45-Lone_Pilot-original-sheet.png]], [[:File:VB6-45-Lone_Pilot.png]]) show the original and PC-E1 texts; the Master List slip and the Players Committee card image the PC-E3 text.

* '''Text source:''' the PC website card list (by 21 July 2012; its written-out icons drawn as on the slips). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “USED: Activate 1 Force. STARTING: ▲ Black Leader, Bossk, Dengar, DS-61-2, or Guri (may also ▲ a matching starship, a system with exactly 1 [Dark Side Force], and an always (Immune to Alter.) Effect). When drawing your starting hand, draw four cards instead of eight. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1261_42</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with this game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
